results.rationale: Consistency: the black/white diamond cushion remains identifiable, but its fabric pattern is disrupted by large patchy marks across the lower half. Instruction: dark sofa, cool modern interior, close-up and bold top-left title appear; malformed possessive punctuation and damaged geometric/fabric detail prevent full compliance. Quality: conspicuous smeared/fragmented pattern patches and erroneous title punctuation are distracting defects.

Consistency: layout, frog body and surrounding hand outlines remain, but the frog's originally blue hand turns red. Instruction: all surrounding hands are filled the same light blue rather than assigned red/blue by handedness. Quality: coherent clean cartoon shapes and uniform color fills. Knowledge: explanation is blank; visible handedness key and instruction imply two matching color classes, contradicted by uniform blue hands and an altered key.
